<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex10012025-04-2516-15-593" status="finalized">       'di la <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3786">lo tsha ba</rs> ni mkhyen pa gsuM dus gsuM dang 'brel pa | rang dang gzhan <expan>thams cad</expan> kyi thun mong ba | 'phags pa'i gang zag <expan>thams cad</expan> kyi rgyud la skye ba | shes bya rgya mtsho lta bu spyi yin la | sbyor ba bzhi dang chos sku × ni sbyor ba nyaMs su len pa po bdag nyid dang 'brel pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu'i bye brag min pas | de'i skra'i rtse mo chu'i tshod tsaM
            <lb n="9b5"/> yin pas de rgya mtsho lta bu der ji ste mi 'du | des na mkhyen pa gsuM la bstod pas brgyad ka la bstod par 'grub po | de'i phyir grangs nyung ba'i skyon med do zhes zer ro || </seg></TEI>
